description: Backend state model the IDE/Tauri frontend (or any other consumer) can render directly. Assembles a flat IDERepairState dataclass from a VerifiedRepairTrace and an optional ApprovalGateDecision. Each dimension is a typed enum slot (intake / verifier / model_route / patch_plan / patch_temp / patch_verifier / source_approval). Carries pointers to lock + evidence files so the consumer can deep-link audit trails. The model is a pure function — no I/O, no model invocation, no source mutation.
purpose: Rung 6 of the verified-repair campaign. Decouples the frontend from the internals of the four prior rungs: an IDE can consume a single JSON record and render the current state without touching trace internals. Sets up DETERMINEX_IDE_BACKEND_FINAL_STATE_LOCK_001 (the campaign-finale rung) to roll up the full backend state into a single packet.
invariants: build_ide_state is a pure function of (trace, approval, lock_paths, evidence_paths).
Accepted ApprovalGateDecision flips source_mutation_authorized to True; blocked decisions flip source_approval to SOURCE_MUTATION_BLOCKED and source_mutation_authorized to False.
An ApprovalGateDecision with decision=SOURCE_MUTATION_APPROVAL_REQUIRED keeps source_approval=SOURCE_APPROVAL_REQUIRED (i.e. REQUIRED is not the same as BLOCKED).
When lock or evidence paths are supplied, the state's statuses_seen contains EVIDENCE_AVAILABLE.
scripts/ide/*.py contains no `import subprocess`, no `import urllib`, no `import socket`, no `import http`.
State assembly does not mutate the original workspace tree (sha256 before==after).
Audit path-rule for scripts/ide/ is LEGACY_EXEMPT_READ_ONLY.
Audit counts: BLOCKED_UNSAFE=0, MUST_MIGRATE=0, UNKNOWN=0, PROGRAMBENCH>=56.
remaining_gaps: No actual UI rendering. This rung exposes the state shape; the Tauri/web frontend is a downstream artifact (deferred).
Live ApprovalGateDecision admission is still gated by the FIXTURE-only acceptance from HUMAN_APPROVAL_SOURCE_MUTATION_GATE_LOCK_001.
Evidence pointers are a flat list of strings; future rungs may add structured pointers (line ranges, anchor URLs) once the IDE rendering is in place.
